protocol.tree_arms: Plain causal600/63 versus same+occupancy/provided condition; both fit only registered fit days
protocol.checkpoint: Minimum checkpoint-phase event/condition Brier every5 epochs; no decision/selection labels seen
protocol.decision: 30-day full-domain threshold calibration,choose incumbent tree there;fixed alpha.25 seed arms/three-seed mean
protocol.selection: 15-day challenger-vs-incumbent paired origin/days;replace only if gain>=.01 and lower95CI>0. No selection retuning.
protocol.assessment: 30 days,load only after selection seal;all policies retain original choices
protocol.label_contract: Eligible noisy public TRAIN observation proxy;existing scored-positive sampler bias not solved
protocol.final: Public development evidence,not final simulation/hidden truth; final simulator seeds unopened

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
